Quick note — congrats, your BrightData account just crossed the self-serve usage threshold we watch for (see attached top-line report). We typically reach out when we see this so teams can move from self-serve to a short tailored walkthrough that helps: 

- map your inference patterns to cost/latency levers,
- review batching & cache opportunities,
- recommend a model/quantization profile that fits your workload.

Would 20–30 minutes this week work for a focused session? A few slots I have open (PDT):
- Tue 6/15, 11:00–11:30am
- Wed 6/16, 3:00–3:30pm
- Thu 6/17, 10:00–10:30am

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

Cc'ing Karthik from our solutions team in case you'd like a technical attendee for the call. Attached: usage_report_BrightData_20270614.csv (summary).

Cheers,
